title: Independence of Namibia
summary: Namibia became independent on 21 March 1990 after UN-supervised elections in November 1989 under Security Council resolution 435. Shortly after midnight the South African flag was lowered and the Namibian flag raised, and UN Secretary-General Javier Perez de Cuellar swore in Sam Nujoma as first president, ending South African rule begun after the First World War.

uncertainty.note: Independence took effect shortly after midnight on 21 March 1990.

beats.caption: UN-supervised elections to a Constituent Assembly were held in November 1989 under Resolution 435; SWAPO won 41 of 72 seats.
Shortly after midnight on 21 March 1990 the Namibian flag replaced the South African flag and Sam Nujoma took the presidential oath.
Namibia became independent, ending South African administration that began after the First World War.
